- `platform_config.postmark_api_token` - Postmark server API token
- `platform_config.email_from_address` - Default: `noreply@rankora.co`
- `platform_config.email_from_name` - Default: `Rankora`
- `platform_config.outbound_email_enabled` - Toggle for sending emails
- `platform_config.email_ingestion_enabled` - Toggle for receiving resumes via email
- `platform_config.email_notify_ranking_complete` - Send ranking complete emails
- `platform_config.email_notify_resume_received` - Send resume received emails

- User fallback inbox: `profiles.inbox_email` (pattern: `{16-char-hash}@inbound.rankora.co`)
- Per-job inbox: `jobs.inbox_email` (pattern: `{10-char-hash}+{8-char-uuid}@inbound.rankora.co`)

**Email Templates:**
- `ranking_complete` - Sent when job ranking finishes
- `resume_received` - Sent when resumes received via email ingestion

- Postmark inbound webhook URL: `https://zkzontawprihrzpayeam.supabase.co/functions/v1/email-ingest`
